regions.full_page: Neil J. Mackinnon - 9 (Tomorrow) - blind in left Eye since May 30th That day when playing. .. fell and had his eye pierced ...... Remarkable .... his older brother now almost 19 .. playing foot ball two years ago lost his sight from a stroke in the left eye and for a month it was hopeless - according to specialists. He is now in service since last March and has a number medals for expert marksmanship - his sight perfect. . Deo Gr.

regions.full_page: Thanks - John Datson - 11 - pronounced spinal-maningitis by two Drs. Aunt phoned enrollment when he was showing every indication of dreaded disease; was home before week was over. Drs. say there are still indications he had it. 13th was here in Monastery this Evening O.K.

regions.full_page: Thanks - C. Howard Menear - 53 - had lost one kidney and the other had been refusing to function. He was dying to all appearance when he asked to be baptized - it was in Carmel Mercy Hospital. Wife had for years been going to Catholic services. Now both are regu- lar communicants. When he got well - Drs said it would be a year before he could go back to work - went back 9 months before sche- dule
